For \(c=2\):  
\[
a=37-2b
\]
with prime \(b\neq 2\). Testing prime \(b\):
- \(b=3 \Rightarrow a=31\), so \(a+b-c=31+3-2=32\)
- \(b=7 \Rightarrow a=23\), value \(28\)
- \(b=13 \Rightarrow a=11\), value \(22\)
- \(b=17 \Rightarrow a=3\), value \(18\)

The maximum in this case is \(32\).

For \(b=2\), similarly the maximum is \(30\). The only other possibility is \(a=2\), giving \(bc=35\), which yields smaller values.

Thus the maximum value is  
\[
\boxed{32}
\]
